findings.title: Foundational tasks run before the duplicate-job and stale-checkout protections with no bootstrap safety procedure
T015 cannot prove and record the merged tree before its own candidate is merged
T010 defines no durable acknowledgement or resume rule for its operator hand-off boundary
T002 conflates operator-only reproduction with the subsequent fix without a staged checkpoint
T013 places the full-suite hermetic proof inside the same test glob it must invoke without requiring a recursion guard
